key_insight: Manual fax routing in cardiology clinics is a large administrative burden that looks highly suitable for agentic AI automation.
clinical_relevance: Reducing fax-handling time could free staff capacity and lower operational costs in healthcare systems without changing direct patient care.
method: Retrospective time study of fax-routing workflows in 3 cardiology clinics.
Counted inbound faxes at a division-wide communication hub over a later 6-month period.
Applied observed labor times to estimate staffing hours and monthly cost burden.
evidence_signal: The study measured fax routing times of 4.4–9.4 minutes per fax and estimated 407 person-hours and $10,663.40 per month for the hub.
watch_item: Findings come from a single tertiary-care center and estimate labor burden rather than testing an AI system in real-world deployment.
paper_title: Agentic Artificial Intelligence as a Catalyst for Administrative Modernization: The Beginning of the End for Traditional Fax Workflows in Healthcare
